A '''light box''' is a puzzle given to the player when doing [[Clue scroll (master)|master]] [[Treasure Trails]]. The goal of the puzzle is to turn all of the lights on.

[[File:Light box interface.png|thumb|left|The light box's interface.]]

==Trivia==
* The appearance of the light box is very similar to that of the [[seed box]]. The only difference is, unlike an open seed box, the light box has no dividers inside of it.
